title: 第1章 瞎少年命途多舛第2章 侠肝胆蚍蜉撼树
slug: 我在大虞当杀手那些年
content_zh:
“你这个瞎子，还回来做什么？”
“你就是个灾星，你会给我们村带来不祥！”
“快滚！快滚！”
大虞皇朝，河州。
一名十岁左右的小男孩，被几个五六岁的稚童挡在村口，还不断有石子砸在身上。
大雪纷飞。
小男孩穿着不合身的粗布麻衣，瘦弱的身体，冻的瑟瑟发抖。
脚下踩着一双草鞋，脚脖子冻的通红。
值得一提的是，他的双眼被一块黑布蒙住。
手里那根细长的竹竿，就是他的“眼睛”。
突然，
一个小胖墩夺过瞎子手里的竹竿，一竹竿打在了瞎子的脑袋上，立时出现一道红肿。
“你应该跟你爷爷一起进棺材！”
“我们村子不欢迎你，你走！”
小胖墩拿着竹竿，一副瞎子不离开，就要下狠手的样子。
“狗蛋！你们在干什么？！”
一名十三四岁的女孩自村外快步跑来。
“是秀秀姐，快跑！”
小胖墩丢下竹竿，招呼几名同伴转身就跑。
“这狗蛋，真是越来越过分了！”

女孩看着一哄而散的一行人，很是气愤。
她捡起地上的竹竿，交到瞎子手中，“阿礼，你的竹竿，下次见到狗蛋，我帮你教训他。”
“他们应该不是故意的，我先回家了。”
“下雪路滑，我送你吧。”
“不用，我能行。”
瞎子用竹竿探路，缓缓往村子里走去。
女孩心有不忍，可家中娘亲喊她吃饭的声音突然传来，只能立即回家。
咯吱～咯吱～
听着踩在雪地上的声音，瞎子知道，离家越来越近了。
路就在脚下，往前走，总能到的。
瞎子名叫裴礼，三天前刚过的十岁生日。
村子叫做福星村，可他却被当成了灾星。
他出生时，母亲难产死了；三岁时，父亲上山打柴摔死了；五岁时，奶奶进城卖竹篓，被马撞死了；三日前，爷爷端菜时绊倒，筷子刺穿了喉咙。
今日是爷爷刚刚下葬归来。
其实村子里一直有传言说裴礼是灾星，只是在爷爷死之前，没人当面说。
现在爷爷死了，他再也没有靠山了。
不过像他这样的克亲之人，或许真的是个灾星…
或许，他也熬不过这个冬天…
content_en:
"You blind man, what are you doing back here?"
"You are a disaster, you will bring bad luck to our village!"
"Get out of here! Get out of here!"
Dayu Dynasty, Hezhou.
A little boy of about ten years old was blocked at the entrance of the village by several children of five or six years old, and he was constantly hit by stones.
It's snowing heavily.
The little boy was wearing unfitting coarse linen clothes, his thin body was shivering from the cold.
He was wearing a pair of straw sandals, and his ankles were red from the cold.
It is worth mentioning that his eyes were covered with a piece of black cloth.
The slender bamboo pole in his hand is his "eye".
suddenly,
A little fat man snatched the bamboo pole from the blind man's hand and hit the blind man on the head with the bamboo pole, causing a red and swollen streak immediately.
"You should be in the coffin with your grandpa!"
"You are not welcome in our village, please leave!"
Little Fatty was holding a bamboo pole, looking like he was going to do something cruel to the blind man if he didn't leave.
"Goudan! What are you doing?!"
A girl of thirteen or fourteen came running quickly from outside the village.
"It's Sister Xiuxiu, run!"
Little Fatty dropped the bamboo pole, called to his companions and ran away.
"This bitch is getting more and more excessive!"
The girl looked at the group of people who dispersed in a hurry and was very angry.
She picked up the bamboo pole on the ground and handed it to the blind man. "Ali, your bamboo pole, next time you see Goudan, I will help you teach him a lesson."
"They probably didn't mean it. I'm going home first."
"It's snowy and the roads are slippery. I'll give you a ride."
"No, I can do it."
The blind man used a bamboo pole to find his way and slowly walked towards the village.
The girl couldn't bear it, but her mother's voice at home suddenly called her to eat, so she had no choice but to go home immediately.
Creak ~ creak ~
Listening to the sound of stepping on the snow, the blind man knew that he was getting closer to home.
The road is at your feet. If you keep moving forward, you can always reach it.
The blind man's name is Pei Li, and he just celebrated his tenth birthday three days ago.
The village is called Fuxing Village, but he is regarded as a disaster star.
When he was born, his mother died in childbirth; when he was three years old, his father fell to death while going up the mountain to collect firewood; when he was five years old, his grandmother went to the city to sell bamboo baskets and was hit by a horse and died; three days ago, his grandfather tripped while serving food and pierced his throat with his chopsticks.
Grandpa just returned from his burial today.
In fact, there have always been rumors in the village that Pei Li was a disaster star, but before his grandfather died, no one said it to his face.
Now that grandpa is dead, he no longer has anyone to rely on.
But a person like him who resists relatives may really be a disaster...
Maybe he won't be able to survive this winter either...
